title: ImpactXCode
description: A starter Visual Studio Code extension.

title: Kitchen Remodeling Cost Planner
description: Kitchen remodeling budget planner for VS Code: split a remodel budget into 12 line items with sales tax, contingency and permits, and insert the breakdown as a Markdown table. Offline, no telemetry.

title: Concrete Contractors Estimator
description: Concrete contractors take-off in VS Code: slab, footing, column and steps volume in cubic yards, ready-mix order, 80/60/40 lb bag counts, rebar and mesh, rough cost. Insert results as a Markdown table. Offline, no telemetry.

title: Context Menu Manager
description: Inspect, organize, and toggle context-menu items contributed by any installed VS Code extension.

title: Owl Lifted
description: Night Owl's syntax colors on a lighter navy, plus a matching soft light theme.
